qa_pairs.question: Someone hacked my account and made an order that is currently Confirmed. What should I do?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Reset password, revoke active sessions, enable MFA, contact Account Security, and attempt to cancel the order.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.
If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should also attempt cancellation under `02_orders_and_payments.md`.

qa_pairs.question: I ordered a device in August 2026. Can I return it unopened after 25 days?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, orders before Sept 1 follow v1.0, which allowed 21 days for unopened devices.

contexts.text: Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices
Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership.

qa_pairs.question: Can I return opened AeroBuds Pro?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, they are treated as hygiene accessories and are non-returnable unless defective.

contexts.text: Opened ear-tip packages are treated as hygiene accessories under `05_returns_and_exchanges.md`.
Opened ear tips, in-ear audio products, screen protectors, and other hygiene or single-use accessories are non-returnable unless defective.

qa_pairs.question: I have OrbitPlus and want to place a domestic order. Do I get free express shipping?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, you get free standard shipping. OrbitPlus does not discount express shipping.

contexts.text: Active members receive free standard shipping on eligible domestic orders
Membership does not discount devices, repair charges, gift cards, taxes, express shipping, or products already marked as clearance.

qa_pairs.question: Can I combine two gift cards with one card payment, and how is it refunded?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes, up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment. The gift-card portion returns to a replacement gift card.

contexts.text: Up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment.
After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days. Gift-card portions return to a replacement gift card.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if a repair part is unavailable for 20 business days?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy, such as a replacement or refund.

contexts.text: If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.
Warranty service may result in repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or refund when the first two remedies are not reasonable.

qa_pairs.question: Does OrbitPlus extend my unopened-device return window and my product warranty?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: It extends the unopened return window to 45 days, but it does not extend a product warranty.

contexts.text: OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days
It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.

qa_pairs.question: If I return a bundle but keep a free gift, what happens to my refund?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Its stated promotional value is deducted from your refund.

contexts.text: If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund.
A free gift that is not returned causes its stated promotional value to be deducted.

qa_pairs.question: My AeroBuds Pro stopped charging after 14 months without damage. Will buying OrbitPlus today convert it into a warranty claim?

contexts.text: The AeroBuds Pro and separately purchased OrbitTech accessories have a 12-month warranty.
it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.

qa_pairs.question: If I buy a NovaBook today and buy OrbitPlus tomorrow, do I get the 45-day return window extension?

qa_pairs.question: Will OrbitTech provide a prepaid return label and refund my standard-shipping fee if I return a phone because I don't like the color?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, prepaid labels are for defects/errors, and standard-shipping fees are not refunded for preference returns.

contexts.text: Original standard-shipping fees are not refunded for preference returns.
